item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-11-08
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天论坛的动静主要来自多个应用和工具项目的更新：CKBolt 发帖介绍并给出测试指南 [S05, S06]，Twine 推出 testnet beta 并调整交易流程 [S09, S07]。QuotaCell 与 CSR 的集成讨论继续 [S01, S02]，Kaze 也确认了首场 Unitour 的日期 [S04]。另外，Rosen Bridge 的 CKB 集成讨论有回应 [S03]，Spark 项目 ckb-adversary 也发布了介绍帖 [S10]。 ## 重点话题 CKBolt 由 TEX Labs 开发，是一个浏览器应用，探索 Bitcoin Lightning 与 Nervos CKB 上 Fiber Network 的互操作 [S05]。帖子还提供了 Lightning 钱包设置指南，方便感兴趣的人尝试 Lightning 与 Fiber 的跨网络 swap [S06]。 Twine 发布 testnet beta，定位为非托管 desk，订单、加密聊天和交易动作走 Nostr，CKB 在双方控制的 Fiber 钱包间移动 [S09]。更新中移除了 JIT inbound 路径，open_channel 不再属于交易，RPC token 也不再需要 channels 写权限 [S07]。ArthurZhang 认为把通道管理移出 Twine 合理，能降低协调者所需权限，并让交易接口可被其他 Fiber 钱包使用 [S08]。 QuotaCell 讨论中，psawyerberlin 解释 CSR 里每个 runner...

item.title: QuotaCell: Let your team spend without handing over the treasury (2 posts)
item.description: Thanks @Ticoworld, great project idea, it really tackles a practical use case. To your question: in CSR, each runner has its own small wallet that the operator funds once. It pays the runner’s transaction fees by itself, and any surplus can be swept automatically to the owner’s address. CSR (CKB Service Runner) could also be a solution for the keeper refill you discussed with @Ayoub_Lesfer. CSR lets independent full nodes run scheduled or on-demand jobs on CKB. Combined with QuotaCell, the split could look like this: QuotaCell sets the limit: how much can be spent, by whom, and to which recipient. item.title: CKBolt: Connecting Bitcoin Lightning and Fiber Network on Nervos CKB (2 posts)
item.description: Hello Nervos community, We are excited to introduce CKBolt, a browser-based application developed by TEX Labs, exploring interoperability between Bitcoin’s Lightning Network and Fiber Network on Nervos CKB. Bitcoin’s Lightning Network is a Layer 2 payment network built on Bitcoin, while Fiber is a peer-to-peer, multi-asset payment and swap network built on Nervos CKB. Both leverage off-chain payment channels to enable fast and efficient transactions. CKBolt brings these two ecosystems together through a unified interface, allowing users to explore cross-network asset swaps and direct payments between Fiber nodes. Our goal is to make cross-network payment interactions more accessible while...

item.title: Twine: Buy and Sell CKB Without Depositing on an Exchange (Fiber P2P PoC) (2 posts)
item.description: Pulling the JIT inbound path. On release, if the buyer could not receive, the daemon opened a private one-way channel from the Twine Fiber node and funded it. That is gone. open_channel is no longer part of a trade. The RPC token no longer needs write("channels") or write("peers"). The daemon pays the buyer’s invoice. It does not open a channel, fund one, or rebalance one. The next piece on that node would have been rebalancing, so the hub kept inbound and outbound in the right direction. Together with JIT, that turns the desk into a liquidity provider. A wallet then has to peer with this hub, stay online, and auto-accept a channel the desk opens. item.title: Twine testnet beta: help test buying and selling CKB without an exchange (1 posts)
item.description: Twine is a non-custodial desk for buying and selling CKB with local money. Orders, encrypted chat, and trade actions go over Nostr. The CKB moves on Fiber, between wallets the two people control. The local currency goes from one account to the other. Twine does not hold the money, and it does not hold a key that can spend the locked CKB. Why this exists Buying or selling CKB for local money still means an exchange, or a KYC ramp. The exchange that lists CKB is not permitted where you live. To sell on a custodial desk, you deposit the coins into the exchange first. If it freezes or bans the account, those coins stay trapped until the exchange decides to give them back. Or you will not hand...

item.title: Spark Program | ckb-adversary: generic attacks on real CKB transactions, before you deploy (1 posts)
item.description: In my own words What it solves. Every CKB lock and type has to refuse the same handful of tricks: skim an output, ride a second cell along, swap a dep, reuse a proof. Most teams test that their script works, not that it refuses. ckb-adversary takes one real transaction your script accepts, tries those tricks on it, and tells you which ones got through and who would lose. Who uses it. Anyone writing or reviewing a CKB script, before deploying: one command on a testnet transaction, or a GitHub Action on every change. Why me. At LusoCryptoLabs we build on CKB every day: the Cellula names contracts on mainnet, a hosted Fiber LSP, fixes merged into Fiber. We built this first for our own...

item.title: CadencePay: recurring payments on CKB where the person paying stays in control (1 posts)
item.description: Hi @Linet_Mugwanja, nice design! Anyone can trigger a collection, but the payout always goes to the creator. That leaves one gap: someone has to show up each period and pay the fee. CKB Service Runner (CSR) can be that keeper: Trigger: “every k blocks” or “at time”, proven via since, so no early runs Service: reads the subscription cell, checks the period, returns the collection tx Payment: the runner takes a tip + fee from a separate job cell, and the creator’s payout is untouched Together with my note on Message in a Cell, that’s two good reasons to join CSR if you run a node: keepers for your own apps, and tips for your node. CSR is fully functional on testnet, Feel free to try a...

item.title: Message in a Cell: seal a letter, a photo or a video with CKB until a day that matters (2 posts)
item.description: Hi everyone! I’m Linnette from the CKBuilders program. After CadencePay ( CadencePay: recurring payments on CKB where the person paying stays in control ), here’s the other project I built: Message in a Cell. The moment it felt real A friend tried it and sealed a message for me. When the countdown ended I opened it, and the letter and the CKB were mine. It was a small thing, but it felt like getting a real letter, from a blockchain. What it does You write a letter, add a photo or record a video or voice note, put some CKB in with it, and seal it until a date. On that day, the person you chose opens it, and the message and the CKB are theirs. It fits CKB naturally: storing data locks 1 CKB...

item.description: Fiber Studio v1.1.4 — relays connect themselves Hi everyone, Fiber Studio v1.1.4 is out. This one is about getting onto the public network without extra setup.
